task: compare zero-quota ways to preserve or materialize small binary content in scheduled Chat

assumptions.forbidden: protected-primary updates, hosted compute, LFS/artifact/package/cloud storage, paid/trial/monthly credits, manual-user conversion

candidates.name: Git create_blob(base64) + tree + commit + isolated branch ref
candidates.conflict_duplication_risk: low when unique branch/op identity and force=false ref updates are used
candidates.monthly_quota_fragility: low; ordinary Git objects only, no metered add-on
candidates.tested: PASS non-UTF8 9-byte probe with exact base64/blob-SHA readback and content-idempotent duplicate blob creation

candidates.name: canonical-base64 text chunks + immutable manifest
candidates.tested: PASS positive plus fail-closed malformed/noncanonical controls

candidates.name: Git LFS
candidates.monthly_quota_fragility: REJECT: documented plan-based storage/bandwidth usage and billing/disable behavior

best_by_outcome.actual_binary_storage: Git create_blob(base64) + tree + commit + isolated branch ref
best_by_outcome.large_binary_or_external_binary_upload: UNRESOLVED; do not substitute LFS/manual handoff under zero-quota rule

falsification_boundary: The selected Git-blob route is not a solution when the material outcome requires execution of the bytes, installation/dependency resolution, a protected-primary path, or submission to a distinct binary-upload API that the scheduled Chat connector cannot invoke.
